hyperedges.rationale: Five concepts from complex systems/network science trace how market order emerges from decentralized interactions: (1) self-organization requires local rules + feedback + fluctuation; (2) swarm intelligence emerges when diverse participants interact; (3) pheromone mechanism drives positive feedback of capital allocation; (4) information cascades show how group decisions override private information; (5) emotional contagion spreads through networks via three degrees of influence. Together they explain how macro market patterns emerge from micro trader behaviors.

hyperedges.label: 市场生命周期的物理模型：耗散结构→Edge蒸发→分支相变→临界雪崩→进化替代
hyperedges.rationale: Five physics-based concepts model the full lifecycle of market opportunities and trading systems: (1) trends as dissipative structures requiring continuous funding; (2) trading edges decaying like Hawking radiation; (3) regime shifts as bifurcation phase transitions; (4) market crashes as self-organized criticality avalanches; (5) strategy evolution through von Neumann's replication-variation-selection cycle. This integrated framework replaces static 'buy and hold' thinking with a dynamic lifecycle approach to market participation.

hyperedges.rationale: Five principles for designing a robust trading strategy system: (1) toolbox perspective maps strategies to market regimes; (2) diversity prediction theorem proves ensemble superiority; (3) Fermi simplicity discipline keeps core rules minimal (<=5, fit on one page); (4) lambda regulation keeps the system at the edge of chaos (optimal information processing); (5) Jammer premise analysis audits hidden assumptions underlying all strategies. Together they form a complete meta-framework for system design — not about finding the best strategy but about building the best strategy-discovery system.

hyperedges.label: 风险管控五层防御：走查预演→序参量监控→全息投影→SOC临界监测→分支点准备
hyperedges.rationale: Five-layer risk management framework synthesized across branches: (1) walkthrough pre-trade mental simulation to identify failure modes; (2) order parameter monitoring to track the market's slow variables; (3) holographic boundary management using a few key metrics to project system health; (4) SOC criticality monitoring (leverage/concentration/crowding) to detect approaching avalanches; (5) bifurcation point preparation — reduce exposure when market enters pre-phase-transition narrow range. Each layer is independent (redundancy), protecting against a different failure mode.

nodes.label: 混沌边缘

nodes.label: 怪圈

nodes.label: 测量问题

nodes.label: 有限理性

nodes.label: 贝叶斯大脑
nodes.definition: 大脑以贝叶斯方式整合先验信念和新证据进行感知和决策

nodes.label: 相变

nodes.label: 历史瞬间

nodes.label: 群体选择

nodes.label: 过度模仿
nodes.definition: 人类比任何物种更忠实地模仿因果链条中看似无关的步骤, 文化积累的基础

nodes.label: QBism

nodes.label: 多世界诠释
nodes.definition: Everett: 所有量子分支都真实存在, 测量不坍缩只是观察者分裂

books: 菜根谭_小窗幽记_围炉夜话
properties.method: 原文精读_按交易主题分组穿透
properties.core_insight: Chinese classical texts contain directly operable trading principles through metaphorical penetration
properties.synthesis_output: Each book produces 20-28 actionable trading signals organized into operational signal tables

properties.core_metaphor: 礼(ritual) = trading system. 礼者君之大柄 = system is the ruler's (trader's) great handle.
system_functions: 别嫌明微_辨别真伪信号
考制度_检验规则有效性
properties.completeness_standard: 体不备不成人 = incomplete system = immature trader. Must have entry/exit/stop/position/risk 5 modules.
properties.unity_principle: 经礼三百_曲礼三千_其致一也 = many rules but one core logic

properties.integration_principle: 巧者和之 = skillfully integrate all three. Most traders have all three but they don't form a闭环.
properties.true_test: 轮敝三材不失职谓之完 = when system breaks down (loss streak/black swan), each module still functions

properties.philosophy: 国工 = not how much you earn, but whether your system passes all six tests

properties.core_principle: 凡构屋之制皆以材为祖 = find your system's fundamental atom (材). All decisions derived from this.
properties.eight_grades: 材有八等度屋之大小 = different capital sizes use different strategies. Small capital=flexible, large capital=stable.
properties.fixed_ratio_variable_value: 各以其材之广分为十五分 = system rules expressed as percentages/ratios, not absolute values
properties.buffer_layer: 栔 = gap layer between components. Cash/time/emotional buffers. 材+栔=足材(complete system).
properties.flexibility_clause: 随宜加减 = within standard framework, allow context-based adjustment. But unlabeled rules must be absolutely enforced.

key_doctrines: 夫曰纪效 = record practical effectiveness. Only methods proven in live combat (实盘) are valid.
花法胜而对手机夫渐迷 = flashy analysis weakens real capability. Regularly prune花法(unnecessary indicators).
平分原则 = live performance ≈ 50% of backtest. Design systems simple enough to execute under fear.
鸳鸯阵 = each system module both attacks and protects the preceding module. 筅救牌_枪救筅_短兵救枪.
束伍 = system organization must be explicit. 一字之种疑百法之是废 = one ambiguous word invalidates the whole.
操手足号令易操其心难 = from mechanical rule-following to internalized understanding.
兵之胜负者气也 = trading state (气) fluctuates. Need a 司气者(system module) to manage it.
properties.mandate_quote: 若犯军令便是我的亲子侄也要依法施行 = rules apply equally to you and your emotions. One exception collapses the entire system.

properties.core_insight: Market's deepest layer is human emotion, not technical analysis. 诗经 writes about greed/fear/hope/despair 2000+ years ago.
properties.four_capacities: 兴_insight_triggered_by_signal + 观_observing_market_ecosystem + 群_communication_verification + 怨_critique_driving_improvement

key_poems_penetration.\u8361: 靡不有初鲜克有终 = most start well few finish. System persistence is rarest quality.
key_poems_penetration.\u6291: 白圭之玷尚可磨也斯言之玷不可为也 = losing money recoverable, breaking system rules irrevocable

properties.hierarchy: 天子之职莫大于礼_礼莫大于分_分莫大于名 = trader's first duty is system integrity. Three layers: philosophy(礼) → rules(分) → signals(名).
properties.sacred_params: 惟名与器不可以假人 = key system parameters (stop/position/signal) cannot be lent to emotion or future self.
properties.early_intervention: 谨微_履霜坚冰至 = act on small signals before they become crises. 治其微用力寡而功多.
properties.talent_virtue_framework: 才德论 = strategy profitability(cai) vs robustness(de). 与其得小人不若得愚人 = prefer low-return robust over high-return fragile.
properties.trust_primacy: 信者人君之大宝 = trust in your system is your greatest asset. 徙木立信 = build trust through small-scale live verification.
properties.ShangYang_execution: 法之不行自上犯之 = rules fail because you yourself break them first. 太子犯法刑其傅 = no exceptions for anyone.
properties.HanWuDi_reform: 晚而改过 = it is never too late to admit error (轮台罪己诏). 有亡秦之失而免亡秦之祸.
properties.Zhenguan_five_virtues: 不嫉善_弃短取长_各得其所_容正直_爱如一 = five qualities for system management

properties.core_command: 应无所住而生其心 = dwell nowhere, let judgment flow naturally. 住则死_不住则活.
three_minds: 过去心不可得 = no attachment to past PnL
现在心不可得 = no certainty in current judgment
未来心不可得 = no prediction of future
properties.ultimate_state: 不取于相如如不动 = not captured by appearances, unmoved within. 离一切诸相即名诸佛 = freedom from all表象.
properties.paradox_statement: 所谓佛法者即非佛法 = the trading system you define is not the trading system. Have a system without being bound by it.

properties.habit_formation: 少成若天性习惯如自然 = start trading correctly from the first trade. habits become nature.
properties.learning_purpose: 开心明目利于行耳 = learning goal is better execution not more knowledge.
properties.self_vs_other_learning: 古之学者为己以补不足 = learn to fix your own weakness. 今之学者为人但能说之 = not for showing off.
properties.focus_principle: 多为少善不如执一 = master one method rather than dabbling in five.
properties.contentment_doctrine: 欲不可纵志不可满_天地恶满盈 = greed must be restrained. 不知止足犹致败累 = even emperors who don't know when to stop fail.
properties.health_metaphor: 养生先须虑祸全身保性 = protect principal before pursuing profit. 养内丧外养外丧内 = balance strategy and risk control.

properties.foundation: 法于阴阳和于术数 = follow market's yin-yang (long-short)规律, align with probabilistic methods.

four_seasons_market.\u6625_spring_layout: 轻仓播种不追涨_该布局时布局
four_seasons_market.\u590f_summer_hold: 让利润奔跑不急于止盈

properties.diagnostic_method: 诊法常以平旦_持脉有道虚静为保 = analyze before market opens, empty预设 and still mind.
properties.risk_progression: 风为百病之长 = small fluctuation is source of all major risks. 当时可治_传变则不治 = stop small losses early.
properties.key_command: 亢则害承乃制 = excess is harmful, must have constraining mechanism (stop/risk control). 夫唯顺而已矣 = go with trend is the only way.

properties.fundamental_premise: 守本离末则富离本守末则贫 = hold the root (discipline/risk/system) abandon the branch (flashy indicators/tips), you prosper.
properties.learning_axiom: 道成于学而藏于书_学进于振而废于穷 = trading mastery through learning, abandoned in loss depression.
properties.knowledge_humility: 虽有至圣不生而知虽有至材不生而能 = even geniuses aren't born knowing. Trading is learned not innate.
properties.greed_warning: 世论贵廉及行释廉 = everyone knows not to be greedy but in action they are. 专利必败 = trying to capture the whole move fails.
properties.multi_perspective: 兼听则明偏信则暗 = multiple angles analysis prevents bias. 明者见形暗者闻声 = see essence not noise.
properties.small_things_matter: 十围木起弱毫_明者慎微智者识几 = giant trees from tiny sprouts. Masters attend to smallest details.
properties.four_layer_trust: 知贤用贤任贤信贤终贤 = know a good strategy → adopt it → entrust it → trust it → persist. Missing any layer voids the system.
properties.post_profit_danger: 富贵太盛则必骄佚而生过 = big profits breed arrogance. 福大愈惧爵隆益恭 = more profit, more fear, more humility.

properties.ontology: 动静无端阴阳无始 = long-short cycles are beginningless and endless. Don't seek the start/end of market.
properties.learning_method: 思则得之不思不得 = independent thinking is essential. 涵养须用敬进学则在致知 = cultivate reverence + pursue knowledge.
properties.knowing_acting_unity: 知而不能行只是知浅 = execution failure is fundamentally cognitive shallowness. Deepen understanding to change behavior.
properties.mind_cultivation: 一为要_无欲则静虚动直 = single-minded desirelessness enables clear seeing and direct acting. 静后见万物有春意 = stillness reveals opportunity.
properties.self_overcoming: 克己先难后易如破竹 = overcoming ego is hard first then easy. 畏尖物便与克下 = face what you fear.
properties.system_governance: 为政须纲纪文章 = build framework before execution. 太山非一石 = system needs multiple strategies not one.
properties.warning: 外物事事好身心不要好 = pursue fancy indicators but neglect inner cultivation. 困之进人生于忧患 = loss is the best teacher.

properties.core_strategy: 双轨制 = new strategy runs alongside old without shock therapy. Old track provides stability, new track grows incrementally.
properties.implementation: 摸着石头过河 = test new strategy with small capital first. Let live results speak, not debate.
properties.incentive_design: 财政联邦主义 = independent evaluation per strategy. Winners get more capital, losers get suspended.
properties.principle: Don't replace whole system at once. Parallel run → validate → gradually merge.

properties.core_distinction: Prediction = separating signal from noise. Most expert predictions over-interpret noise.
properties.bayesian_update: Every new information is a probability update opportunity, not a binary buy/sell signal.
properties.overfitting_warning: If backtest is perfect → probably perfectly fit noise. 3-variable model beats 30-variable model.
properties.self_assessment_bias: Don't evaluate yourself on last 10 trades. Use last 100+ trades for statistical significance.
properties.probability_calibration: Say '65% probability up' not 'will go up'. Verify calibration: does your 70% prediction actually win ~70% of time?
properties.consensus_intelligence: Crowd consensus works in normal markets, fails at turning points. Contrarian at extremes = alpha source.

properties.institution_definition: Your trading system = your institution. Formal rules + informal habits + enforcement mechanism.
properties.path_dependence: Your trading style is likely locked by your FIRST profitable method, not the OPTIMAL one. QWERTY phenomenon.
properties.incremental_critical_junction: Most evolution is incremental tweaks. But consecutive losses signal need for SYSTEM-level restructuring.
properties.informal_constraint: Best rules are habits needing zero willpower. Goal is not more rules but internalized discipline.
properties.inclusive_vs_extractive: Inclusive system learns from losses and evolves. Extractive system denies losses and collapses.
properties.modular_design: Break path dependence through modular design. Each component replaceable independently. Evolvability > current optimality.

properties.confidence_multiplier: Profit → confidence → bigger positions → more profit → overconfidence → blow-up. Reduce position size after big wins.
properties.confidence_asymmetry: Confidence drops 3x faster than it rises. Consecutive losses exhaust confidence capital. Pause to rebuild.
properties.narrative_driven_market: Market is narrative-driven not data-driven. Buy at story fermentation stage, sell at consensus stage.
properties.fairness_trap: 'Unfair' feeling is system-1 protest. Market doesn't owe you fairness. Ignore fairness heuristic in decisions.
properties.fraud_increase_warning: Bull markets increase fraud (easier to hide). Be extra vigilant about counterparty risk in late-cycle.
properties.money_illusion: Convert all PnL to annualized percentage. Ignore nominal amounts. Small share price drop in big position hurts more than big drop in small position.
properties.pre_trade_checklist: Before each trade: 1) Confidence level 2) Fairness feeling 3) Fraud risk 4) Money illusion 5) Narrative stage

properties.core_insight: Design your trading environment so correct action is the easiest path. Don't rely on willpower.
properties.default_power: 默认设置 = your defaults determine most behavior. opt-in 42% vs opt-out 86%. Set defaults for stop/position/review.
properties.anchor_effect: Your entry price anchors all subsequent judgments. Solution: write analysis before looking at current price.
properties.social_influence: Awareness of FOMO/herd influence is the first defense. Ask: 'Would I buy this if no one else was?'
properties.feedback_loop: Shorten the cycle from decision to feedback. Daily review, link each signal to outcome. Delayed feedback = no learning.
properties.hidden_cost_visualization: Annualize all transaction costs (commission/slippage/tax). Visualize them as a single number. Usually 20-50% of profits.
properties.decision_fatigue: Never make major decisions near market close. Decision quality degrades after dozens of micro-decisions.
properties.libertarian_paternalism: System defaults do the right thing. User retains override power but must consciously exercise it.

properties.minimax_protection: Assume worst-case market direction → size position so worst loss is survivable. This is not prediction but protection.
properties.zero_sum_clarification: Your counterparty is not 'the market' but other traders with different constraints. Someone selling may be forced not bearish.
properties.tit_for_tat_optimal: Axelrod's winning prisoner's dilemma strategy: 1) Be nice (don't trigger恶性cycle) 2) Be retaliatory (stop loss immediately) 3) Be forgiving (no grudge) 4) Be simple (predictable).
properties.repeated_game_mindset: Each trade is one step in infinite repeated game. One-shot mindset (heavy bet/gamble) → death. Repeated mindset (system/stop/management) → survival.
properties.credible_commitment: Hard stop-loss order = burning the bridge. Commitment is not willpower but removing the option to cancel.
properties.signal_cost_principle: Reliable signals are those where the sender also bears risk. Insider buying > analyst recommendation. Big blocks with no cancellation > big blocks with frequent cancellations.

properties.non_equilibrium: Market never arrives at equilibrium. It's always BECOMING equilibrium but never reaching it. Stop asking 'where should price be', ask 'which direction is the process moving'.
properties.increasing_returns: Positive feedback locks in early movers even if technically inferior. VHS beat Betamax. Hot sectors attract more capital → get hotter.
properties.el_farol_problem: If everyone sees the same signal and acts on it, the prediction self-destructs. Your edge = seeing something different or earlier.
properties.technology_as_recombination: No truly new strategies exist. All strategies = recombination of existing elements (MA + RSI + volume). Innovation = new combination for specific question.
properties.domain_boundedness: Each strategy is a lens. It illuminates some things and blinds you to others. Knowing your domain's boundary is more important than its capability.
properties.historical_determination: Your trading preferences are likely locked by early偶然success. First step of evolution = admit your path is historically contingent.
properties.no_permanent_optimum: No permanently optimal strategy exists because market context constantly changes. System maintenance = daily task, not one-time design.

properties.knowledge_problem: You never have complete information. But price itself is a knowledge aggregation mechanism. Respect price as summary of all分散knowledge.
properties.entrepreneurial_alertness: Kirzner: profit comes from seeing what others miss. Alertness ≠ more indicators. Train perception to notice differences in familiar patterns.
properties.subjective_value: No intrinsic value. Value = each participant's subjective evaluation. Before asking 'what is this worth', ask 'who is pricing it'.
properties.time_preference: Your time preference (willingness to wait) determines your suitable strategy. Short-term high time preference → day trading. Long-term low time preference → investing. Strategy must match time preference.
properties.spontaneous_order: Market was not designed by anyone. It emerged from millions of non-intentional actions. Your system also emerges from practice, not pure theory. Respect what你cannot know.
properties.price_signal_dependence: Without price feedback you cannot evaluate decisions. Distorted prices (manipulation/suspended/illiquid) = corrupted decision feedback.

properties.expanded_margin: Safety margin is not a valuation metric (PB<1). It's humility toward uncertainty. The error tolerance your system can absorb.
properties.avoid_loss_first: Rule 1: Don't lose money. Rule 2: Don't forget rule 1. Risk management priority IS the source of excess return.
properties.unconstrained_advantage: Individual investors' biggest edge = no quarterly performance pressure, no benchmark, no redemption risk. Can wait 3 months for opportunity.
properties.price_vs_value: Price is Mr. Market's emotion. Value is your analysis. Price may diverge long-term not because market is wrong but because its pricing logic differs.
properties.liquidity_risk: Most underrated risk factor. Evaluate position not by average daily volume but by 'how many days to exit in crisis'. Discount liquidity into safety margin.
properties.catalyst_requirement: Cheap without catalyst = value trap. Every buy must answer: what event triggers value回归? Performance improvement/asset disposal/management change/industry cycle.
properties.cash_as_option: Cash is not uninvested money. Cash is an active position with value = option to buy low in future crisis.
properties.depth_over_breadth: Deep research on few names beats shallow coverage of many. Conviction during price fluctuation comes from depth not diversification.

properties.non_normal_distribution: Markets follow fractal power-law distribution (α≈1.7), not normal distribution. 6σ events occur every few years, not once in 10^18 years. VaR/Sharpe/standard deviation based on normal distribution are dangerous illusions.
properties.scale_invariance: Price patterns are self-similar across time scales. 5min chart ≈ daily chart ≈ monthly chart. Your chosen timeframe is a filter/interpretation choice.
properties.volatility_clustering: Volatility comes in clusters. Calm follows calm, storm follows storm. Adjust position size to current volatility regime.
properties.fat_tail_frequency: Extreme events (7σ in normal) occur every 30-40 years in real markets. Tail risk is structural, not a 'what if'. Tail events can constitute 50% of total risk.
properties.correlation_breakdown: Correlations converge to 1.0 during crises. Diversification fails exactly when needed most. Tail risk requires tail hedging not diversification.
properties.hurst_exponent: H>0.5 = trending regime, H<0.5 = mean-reverting regime. Identifying current regime (trending vs oscillating) is more important than any specific indicator.
properties.pattern_skepticism: Most chart patterns (head-shoulders, double-bottom) can be generated by fractal random processes. Require 100+ sample statistical validation before trusting any pattern.

properties.decoy_effect: Others' returns/positions are your decoy. They distort your relative judgment. Block comparison: you need only your own strategy and discipline.
properties.self_anchoring: First profitable method anchors all future behavior. Break self-anchoring = evolve. Look only at future expected value, not past patterns.
properties.free_trap: Zero-commission → overtrading. Free information → over-reliance. 'Free' is the most expensive in trading as it bypasses理性calculation.
properties.hot_cold_empathy_gap: Your calm-state plans (I will definitely stop loss) are invalid in emotional states. Only mechanical rules survive temperature change.
properties.endowment_effect: Ownership doubles perceived value. Test: 'If I didn't own this, would I buy it at current price?' If no → sell immediately.
properties.door_closing_discipline: Closing positions/deleting watchlists/abandoning strategies is more important than opening new ones. Each open position dilutes attention.
properties.expectation_filter: Your expectations filter what you see from data. Before reading data, write the counter-hypothesis first.
properties.cash_abstraction: Digital money feels less real than cash. Treat every yuan as cash regardless of source (profit/margin/floating gain).
properties.external_constraint: Hard stop order > written plan > self-discipline. Willpower is the most depleted resource by end of trading day.

properties.invisible_hand_trust: Good system needs minimal daily intervention. If you're constantly micro-managing, system design is wrong. Trust the rules to produce good long-term results.
properties.division_of_labor: Master one pattern (breakout/value/arbitrage) → skill deepens → intuition forms. Specialization is efficiency not limitation.
properties.marginal_decision: Only marginal matters: what is the expected value of the NEXT unit? Sunk costs/average costs/past profits are irrelevant.
properties.Keynes_beauty_contest: Don't pick what YOU think is beautiful. Pick what you think the judges will think is beautiful. And further: what judges think judges will think. Third-layer reasoning.
properties.sunk_cost_rule: 你的买入价_已亏金额_历史盈利 = all irrelevant to current decision. Only forward-looking expected value matters.

properties.source: 菜根谭_小窗幽记_围炉夜话
properties.true_flavor_is_bland: 醲肥辛甘非真味真味只是淡 = complex strategies are not the true way. The best method is simple and plain.
properties.moderation_in_all: 路径窄处留一步_滋味浓时减三分 = when market is crowded leave room. Let others eat the last bite.
properties.post_profit_warning: 居盈满者切忌再加一滴 = account full? Don't add a single drop more. Profit → reduce not increase.
properties.emotional_mastery: 气收自觉怒平_神敛自觉言简 = breathing controls anger, focus controls speech. 冷眼冷耳冷情冷心 = four colds for objective trading.
properties.error_acceptance: 昨日之非不可留_今日之是不可执 = yesterday's loss don't dwell, today's win don't cling. 知过能改便是圣人之徒 = knowing and correcting error is mastery.
properties.patience_primacy: 十分不耐烦乃为人大病 = impatience is the great disease. 江山风月闲者为主 = the one who waits is the market's master.

three_mirrors.\u9274\u4e4e\u524d_history_mirror: past market data is the best textbook. Learn from historical patterns.
three_mirrors.\u9274\u4e4e\u4eba_others_mirror: learn from successful traders and be warned by failed ones.
three_mirrors.\u9274\u4e4e\u955c_self_record_mirror: your own trading record is the most honest mirror.

properties.decision_hierarchy: 知人_知言_知义 = understand participants → understand market language → understand principle. Reverse: first understand principle, then read market, then know participants.
properties.contrarian_wisdom: 善钧从众 = true consensus is following what is right, not following the crowd. If crowd does wrong it's not consensus.
properties.reference_then_decide: 公断优于独断 = decide after wide reference (多因子交叉验证) not before. 参而断谓之公断_不参而断谓之独断.
properties.bending_to_stretch: 尺蠖之屈以求伸也 = a loss/stop is bending to prepare for next stretch. 屈而不伸失其所以屈 = stop but never re-enter = lost the meaning of stopping.

mappings.merged_insight: Strategy health (德/robustness) should dominate return (才/profit). Prefer low-return robust over high-return fragile.
Letting go of attachment to positions/outcomes is the antidote to hot-cold empathy gap.
System modules should both create value and protect each other. Modular replaceability ensures evolvability.
Market has no fixed equilibrium but seasonal rhythms. Follow the process direction, don't seek the destination.
Fixed ratios + variable values = system that scales across capital sizes without losing coherence.
Market moves on narrative and emotion. '兴'(insight triggered) + '观'(observing) = sensing narrative shifts before they become consensus.
Multi-angle analysis (兼听) = Bayesian updating. Each new data point updates probability, preventing偏信(confirmation bias).
Six inspections are a quality assurance system design. Thaler shows environment design > willpower. Both are systematic approaches to execution quality.

mappings.chinese_classic: 资治通鉴_惟名与器不可以假人
mappings.merged_insight: Your system's sacred parameters (stop/position) cannot be delegated to emotion. Hard commitment mechanism is the only way to preserve them.

properties.penetration: 同一信息用正反两种框架看一遍，不同结论=没看到真相
估值用保守假设留20%+折扣空间，保证判断错误时不会出局
大跌时悲观=机会，大涨时乐观=风险，市场先生为你服务而非指导你
新策略=已有元素的新组合，不追求全新
策略决定了你看不到什么，跨域创新=最大创新来源
初始条件微小差异被指数放大，放弃精确预测转向弹性应对
趋势和震荡是同一吸引子的两面，策略需在两个区域都有效
参数微变导致系统质变，波动膨胀+相关突变=系统质变前兆
大崩溃不需要大原因，连续小亏=沙子在积累，耐心等临界
每天高质量决策次数有限，保护低熵状态比多盯盘更重要
快乐来自现实超预期不是赚钱，连续盈利后调低预期
区分合理卖出和受不了不确定性卖出，最小化不确定性=交易终极驱动力
关注共识网络在增加还是减少，股票价值来自多少人也在关注它
波动压缩+量能积累=接近临界点，临界点前买入是最大超额收益来源
拥抱波动不追求平稳，远离平衡态才有活力
承认认知带宽有限，压缩到3-5个关键信号
每个指标减少多少不确定性，不减少就扔掉
资金规模变了策略必须跟着变，小资金超线性大资金亚线性
资金流向比价格涨跌更本质，趋势交易的数学基础不是动量是优先连接
识别龙头Hub优先分配仓位，最大风险不是个股基本面变是Hub连接结构变
市场预测有根本上限，不是数据不够是问题本身没有通用算法
市场可压缩性变化=趋势信号，K的突变比价格突变更有预测价值
波动率+相关结构突变=体制相变，相变中不依赖旧相的技术指标
策略失效≠策略不好是环境变了，市场在有效和非理性之间切换
过度同步=群体思维=丧失多样性=系统脆弱，所有人看法一致=危险信号
探索期高温广泛尝试，执行期低温精细优化，市场变时升温重新探索
确定性是一种定价过高的奢侈品，交易中的确定性大多是幻觉
识别自己在哪个象限反向校准偏好，不同概率-损益组合风险偏好完全不同
不提前坍缩到多空，维持概率判断，只有必须执行时才坍缩到具体仓位
测持仓间的相关结构比个股分析重要，相关结构突变重写整个组合风险
不复制别人的交易，路径依赖不可复制，复制代码不复制认知状态
策略被充分定价前及时退出，持续寻找未被充分探索的模式
频繁盯盘冻结判断，留出自由演化时间窗口
保护基金资本(纪律/心态/知识体系)不被消耗，钱可再赚纪律难恢复
你的市场判断是你的信息编码结果，改信息质量比改判断本身重要
用结构化信息空间生成概率，结构化概率生成远优于直觉概率
绘制盈利亏损分布曲线，交点位置=真实edge，将系统评估从感觉变可测量
确保没有任何单笔亏损大到让指数平均发散，尾部生存策略
交易前后量化认知熵变化，元认知层级反馈信号
承认对市场处于混合态，列出所有可能情景及其概率
每次只分析部分信息时知道对什么做了trace out，明白丢失了什么
用3-5条不违反的公理统领全部交易规则，不自相矛盾
交易系统必须设计约束风控纪律，否则自动走向混乱亏损
不同决策场景用不同持仓势，选错视角=正确答案错问题
正反馈追涨杀跌=凸性使系统不稳定，负反馈截断亏损=凹性使系统稳定
收益最大化和风险最小化是同一问题的Legendre变换两面
问规则不问偏好，规则和偏好可能完全相反
给市场留余地长期有利，不榨干最后一分钱
每笔交易分解盈利=运气vs能力，亏损=错误vs概率
L0-L1主导时做趋势，L2-L3主导时做反转
大涨后不追大跌后不割等均值回归，极端表现不会持续
不看单笔盈亏看100笔的统计结果，心理账户设得越宽决策越理性
不要我要赚钱，要我要执行系统，目标的欺骗性越追逐越得不到
连续交易后强制暂停，爆发期决策质量低于平均
上涨+媒体关注+新人涌入=泡沫三件套
这个故事昨天也成立吗还是因为涨了才成立，这次不一样是最贵的四个字
识别当前阶段比预测还会涨多少更重要，阶段1-3参与4-5撤退6保命
系统在波动率上升时受益，大多数时间小亏少数时间大赚
市场是幂律分布，正态分布工具VaR标准差在极端斯坦毫无意义
最优策略不是最大化收益是最小化未来的后悔
杠杆是双刃剑用但要永远留够不被毁灭的部分
每个交易概念必须能转化为操作指令，不能操作的概念没有意义
交易信号影响范围有限，尊重你影响不到的市场界限
连亏是正常涨落，真实edge需要足够多样本才能显现
精力花在管理持仓态质量上，测量结果平仓是ρ的函数
过量信息退化判断质量，控制信息摄入量以保持判断相干性

分散化防不了系统性Hub级冲击，需要随机层+定向层双层防御
策略有效期递减是物理必然，提前准备下一个
接受自己是有限Human用系统弥补缺陷，不强迫自己做Econ

properties.key_insight: 度分布呈幂律，少数枢纽节点拥有大部分连接

properties.key_insight: 高聚类系数+短路径长度，仅需1%随机重连即可大幅缩短路径
properties.trading_application: 持仓品种间存在意想不到的短路径，识别桥接品种，1%调整可能产生跃迁

properties.key_insight: 大量适应性主体交互产生涌现现象，反馈闭环永不停止
properties.trading_application: 市场是CAS，优势不在预测在适应速度，系统需具备四大要素

properties.trading_application: 自下而上设计底层规则让系统涌现表现，观测组合夏普>加权夏普

properties.key_insight: 正反馈驱动增长/崩溃，负反馈驱动稳定，延迟是系统振荡主因

properties.key_insight: 系统中微小变化可引发巨大行为改变的干预点，从参数到范式共12级
properties.trading_application: 从最强杠杆(交易目标/市场假设)开始审查，认知性杠杆比技术性杠杆更有价值

properties.key_insight: 系统在有序与混沌之间达到最优适应，计算能力最大
properties.trading_application: 80%纪律+20%酌情，纪律保持稳定，酌情允许创新，比例随波动率动态调节

properties.key_insight: 所有表现出非平凡复杂性的系统在计算能力上等价
properties.trading_application: 你无法比市场聪明，优势来自策略程序与市场程序的有用不对齐

properties.key_insight: 某些过程不能被加速预测，只能运行它等待结果
properties.trading_application: 分析30分钟仍不能决定→小仓位试，参与优于分析

properties.key_insight: 一维时间序列可嵌入高维相空间发现低维确定性结构

properties.key_insight: 系统中每种分子的生产都被系统内另一种分子催化，系统自我维持
properties.trading_application: 策略间建信息催化环，从操控者变园艺师，系统自我运转

properties.key_insight: 系统接近相变时从扰动中恢复的速度变慢，是体制切换前兆
properties.trading_application: 检测价格自相关衰减时间变长+多框架同时慢化→减仓30-50%+策略切换准备

properties.key_insight: 创新来自当前状态的边界上的一小步，不是远距离跳跃
properties.trading_application: 为每个策略绘邻接可能地图，分配10%预算探索边界，跨越太大预警

properties.key_insight: 只有能从底层规则生成宏观现象才算真正理解
properties.trading_application: 能从简单市场假设+策略规则生成与真实相似的结果才算理解策略

properties.key_insight: 系统中主体的差异是适应性的关键来源，同质化导致集体脆弱
properties.trading_application: 策略间核心逻辑假设必须不同(趋势/均值回归/事件驱动)，参数不同但逻辑同=伪异质

properties.key_insight: 模块度Q量化社区结构质量，Q>0.3有显著社区结构
properties.trading_application: 持仓做社区检测，Q>0.7=健康多社区，社区漂移(不同社区同涨)=系统性风险信号

properties.key_insight: 当感染比例超过阈值时整个网络突然翻转，产生级联效应
properties.trading_application: 监控品种关注度/成交量接近历史阈值=级联将触发，反级联时系统减仓不等确认

properties.key_insight: 系统规律性的描述长度，不是总复杂度，完全随机系统有效复杂度为零
properties.trading_application: 审计每个指标捕捉了什么独立可持续的规律，答不出=装饰复杂度删除

properties.key_insight: 在正确的抽象层级上观察系统，暴露规律隐藏噪声
properties.trading_application: 找到基础交易尺度的最优粗粒化，小尺度=噪声大尺度=参考

properties.key_insight: 干预激活系统补偿性反馈抵消干预效果，不是执行不力是结构性的
properties.trading_application: 每次干预前预判补偿性反馈(买→谁卖卖→谁接)，区分反馈(有限)vs反转(持续)

properties.key_insight: 系统对常规扰动稳健但对特定罕见攻击极端脆弱
properties.trading_application: 长期稳健可能意味着高度优化于常规市场，用未见场景压力测试

properties.key_insight: 人类行为呈长时间静默+短时间密集行动的幂律等待时间模式
properties.trading_application: 爆发期内设决策间隔(<15分钟1决策)，静默期安排非决策任务

properties.key_insight: 个体行为通过邻居传播反馈放大为大的集体变化
properties.trading_application: 正向乘数用移动止盈让利润奔跑，负向乘数等衰竭再介入

properties.key_insight: 人类更关注近期变化(流量)而忽视累积的总量(存量)，导致认知偏差
properties.trading_application: 每日复盘先审存量(总风险/集中度)再流量(今日盈亏)，最危险=存量高但今天还在赚

properties.key_insight: 每个适应性主体占据特定生态位，创新=发现新生态位避免直接竞争
properties.trading_application: 找比较优势生态位深耕并设壁垒，同时设探索性生态位群作为演化期权

properties.key_insight: 好的控制不需要好的预测，强负反馈可补偿弱预测不足
properties.trading_application: 资源投入控制(仓位/止损/应对)的回报远高于投入预测，控制是乘数效应

properties.key_insight: 系统大部分变异不致命的能力，是演化的前提不是结果
properties.trading_application: 变异鲁棒性测试：参数随机变10%后回撤变化<2x=可演化，可演化性比当前性能更重要

properties.key_insight: 最简单的规则(8条子规则)经大量迭代产生图灵完备的复杂行为
properties.trading_application: 简单规则3-5条+大量迭代=涌现的复杂适应性，不追求规则复杂度

properties.operation: 爆发期内设决策间隔(15分钟最多1决策)，静默期安排非决策任务
P0止损/风控→P1持仓调整→P2计划内开仓→P3探索，P0绝对不可被P2打断
每个板块先找枢纽品种(市值/成交/影响力最大)，它们预示板块走向早反应1-3天

properties.source_book: Buchanan 网络社会的三种力量
properties.operation: 每周三维诊断(结构-枢纽状态/状态-波动积累/输出-尾部厚度)，两层以上预警时行动
一级官方公告直接通过，二级主流媒体事实核查后进，三级社交媒体默认抑制
对每个策略追问为什么(机制)不只是什么时候(规律)，规律在市场变时失效机制调整适应
估算各策略决策到PnL体现延迟时间，评估周期<延迟时不调整，做→等→看→改
市场同步度三区间：<0.3减仓观望/0.3-0.7正常交易/>0.7大幅减仓，同步度=仓位+策略选择核心参考
每个品种/状态先测预测窗口，窗口内交易窗口外止损，趋势窗口长震荡窗口短
正向乘数移动止盈让利润奔跑，负向乘数等衰竭再介入，乘数衰竭=新买入者枯竭
从最强杠杆(交易目标/市场假设/系统规则)开始审查再向下，弱杠杆在强杠杆正确后才做
不被常识限制枚举简单规则组合，系统扫描参数空间，用交叉验证防过拟合
每个指标问捕捉了什么独立可持续的规律，答不出=装饰复杂度删除
确保策略间核心逻辑假设不同(趋势/均值回归/事件驱动)，参数不同但逻辑同=伪异质

properties.source_book: Solé & Goodwin 复杂性的迹象
properties.operation: 自相关系数上升+方差增大+相关性跳升=临界状态预警，减仓+双预案+紧止损
明确规划层(数据/风控/资金)和涌现层(买卖信号让策略自己决定)的分界
为每个策略画邻接可能地图(增加过滤/替换指标/扩展品种)，分配10%预算探索
持仓做社区检测模块度Q>0.7=健康，定期检测社区漂移=系统性风险信号
每个决策至少3条独立路径一致才执行，数据源/分析框架/时间尺度三层面都需路径冗余
检查目标/传感器/比较器/执行器四要素，缺一就不是控制系统
资源投入控制(仓位/止损/应对)优于投入预测，控制是乘数效应预测是加法
策略间建信息催化环(A输出催化B→B输出催化C→C反馈A)，从操控者变园艺师
测变异鲁棒性(参数随机变10%后回撤变化)，<2x=可演化>4x=先加固基础架构
找比较优势生态位深耕做壁垒，设探索性生态位群(演化期权)，生态位资源萎缩时迁移

water_philosophy_in_trading
量子认知五支柱：概率幅→信息上限→重置成本→延迟测量→非定域关联
hyperedges.rationale: Five concepts from quantum mechanics branch form a coherent cognitive framework for trading: (1) probability amplitude thinking replaces classical probability with interference effects; (2) Holevo bound sets absolute limits on information extraction; (3) Landauer principle defines cognitive reset cost; (4) delayed measurement preserves quantum coherence; (5) Bell correlations reveal non-local market structure. Together they shift trader cognition from classical to 'quantum' paradigm.

hyperedges.label: 市场自组织五部曲：局部规则→群体智能→信息素正反馈→信息级联→网络情绪传播
hyperedges.rationale: Five concepts from complex systems/network science trace how market order emerges from decentralized interactions: (1) self-organization requires local rules + feedback + fluctuation; (2) swarm intelligence emerges when diverse participants interact; (3) pheromone mechanism drives positive feedback of capital allocation; (4) information cascades show how group decisions override private information; (5) emotional contagion spreads through networks via three degrees of influence. Together they explain how macro market patterns emerge from micro trader behaviors.

hyperedges.label: 市场生命周期的物理模型：耗散结构→Edge蒸发→分支相变→临界雪崩→进化替代
hyperedges.rationale: Five physics-based concepts model the full lifecycle of market opportunities and trading systems: (1) trends as dissipative structures requiring continuous funding; (2) trading edges decaying like Hawking radiation; (3) regime shifts as bifurcation phase transitions; (4) market crashes as self-organized criticality avalanches; (5) strategy evolution through von Neumann's replication-variation-selection cycle. This integrated framework replaces static 'buy and hold' thinking with a dynamic lifecycle approach to market participation.

hyperedges.label: 策略系统架构五原则：工具箱分类→多样性红利→简洁规则→λ边界调节→前提审计
hyperedges.rationale: Five principles for designing a robust trading strategy system: (1) toolbox perspective maps strategies to market regimes; (2) diversity prediction theorem proves ensemble superiority; (3) Fermi simplicity discipline keeps core rules minimal (<=5, fit on one page); (4) lambda regulation keeps the system at the edge of chaos (optimal information processing); (5) Jammer premise analysis audits hidden assumptions underlying all strategies. Together they form a complete meta-framework for system design — not about finding the best strategy but about building the best strategy-discovery system.

hyperedges.label: 风险管控五层防御：走查预演→序参量监控→全息投影→SOC临界监测→分支点准备
hyperedges.rationale: Five-layer risk management framework synthesized across branches: (1) walkthrough pre-trade mental simulation to identify failure modes; (2) order parameter monitoring to track the market's slow variables; (3) holographic boundary management using a few key metrics to project system health; (4) SOC criticality monitoring (leverage/concentration/crowding) to detect approaching avalanches; (5) bifurcation point preparation — reduce exposure when market enters pre-phase-transition narrow range. Each layer is independent (redundancy), protecting against a different failure mode.
